Evaluators read both insights, compare them, and choose the more insightful one, writing the chosen insight or indicating left/right choice.

Insightfulness measures the quality of an insight. More concretely, it measures criteria like • How impactful/actionable the insight is, if it can lead to any key actions and what the impact of those actions would be • How interesting and relevant is the information provided • How clear, precise and coherent the insight is
